title: Enchantments Encore - Mending Incompatibilities Removed
description: Any repair-type enchantments that are incompatible with Mending are now compatible with Mending.
body:
This datapack removes the Mending enchantment incompatibility from the [Enchantments Encore](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchantments-encore) mod. Currently this only affects the Handyman and Sacrifice enchantments.

I made this datapack for the purpose of creating compatibility with another mod called Persistent Enchantment, which changes the functionality of Mending.

The use case was, the [Persistent Enchantment](https://modrinth.com/mod/persistent-enchantment) allows items to work like an Elytra, where when the durability of an item is completely finished, the item isn't destroyed but just is unusable until repaired, and also XP doesn't repair the item. But the mod has two modes, override the existing mending, or add Persistent as a new enchantment. However, I didn't want Mending on the server so I used override. But after several months of using Persistent Enchantment configured like that, I then added Enchantments Encore and came into this issue. And it was more trouble to modify everyone's gear that currently has Persistent(with the `minecraft:mending` enchantment ID) so I made this.

This was not made for the intent of abusing Enchantments Encore under normal use, but it could be done...I think.
